summary: Server singleton of the interrupt feature: three request queues (macOS query pairs it with esv::interrupt::DataSingletonComponent). Seen once in an idle level, empty. open_questions: No game system reads or fills the three arrays in bg3.exe (only the creator, the destructor and a shutdown query bg3.exe+0x35797E0 that removes the entity; the macOS index lists no writer either): the element types are identified by their sizes and destroyed members, which match SE's StartRequestData / StopRequestData / UpdateInterruptorsRequestData exactly; the variant storage of the event is kept raw.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
second_pass: The three element strides (0x160/0x120/0x50) and every destroyed member (event variant at +0x10 with its index byte at event+0xA8, Array at +0xE0, HashMaps at +0x118 and +0x10) were read in bg3.exe destructors; they match Script Extender's esv::interrupt::StartRequestData, StopRequestData and UpdateInterruptorsRequestData (Interrupt.h) member for member, whose remaining offsets were taken from there.
